ammonia.reason: Very short ripening limits deamination and urease activity, little free NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Sheep pasture-derived p-cresol, indole and guaiacol from raw-milk microflora.

bitter.reason: Early hydrophobic peptides from rennet and wild Lactobacillus proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl-ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: High moisture low-pH paste browns poorly; limited Maillard lactose-casein.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation to diacetyl and acetoin 6-20% TIC by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis to butanoic, hexanoic, octanoic acids by lamb lipase and LAB esterases.

creaminess.reason: 52-56% moisture, 19-26% fat ground salted curd gives spreadable creamy matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Milled salted lump forms cohesive paste, not crumbly calcium-phosphate fracture.

firmness.reason: Soft high-moisture unpressed curd with pH 5.1-5.3 demineralized casein network.

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate esterification by LAB esterases.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk branched C8-C10 acids 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic lipolysis.

melt.reason: High moisture acid curd softens and flows moderately despite pH 5.1.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid lipoxygenase, no rind flora.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat in high moisture stable emulsion, little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Trace guaiacol phenol from feed/microflora, product not smoked.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic plus acetic acid 7-11% TIC from heterofermentative LAB, pH 5.1.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, acid-rennet curd has no aligned fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No cook step, minimal heat-induced methionine and whey-protein H2S.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and acetoin/2,3-butanediol give slight sweet note vs salt-sour.

umami.reason: Early proteolysis releases glutamate and savory peptides in salted lump.
